title: Lazy string iterators allocate a wrapper with no owner
claim: The returned lazy sequence gets an extra capturing closure before an owner/activity check; an escaping SplitSeq adds 32 B and one allocation per call in inactive mode.
repro_command: Copy .omo/review/evidence/perf-hotpath/hotpath_review_test.go into iast/propagation/hotpath_review_test.go in a private checkout; GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 go test -run '^$' -bench '^BenchmarkHotPathReview/(no-owner|active-clean)/(join-empty|split-seq)' -benchtime=100ms -count=1 -benchmem -timeout=15m ./iast/propagation

title: Clean writer writes scan owner slots without taint or writer state
claim: WriterActive gates on owner rather than value or writer state; with one clean owner every builder/buffer write enters writer bookkeeping, including 64-owner-slot lookups even with no tracked writer.
repro_command: Copy .omo/review/evidence/perf-hotpath/hotpath_review_test.go into iast/propagation/hotpath_review_test.go in a private checkout; GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 go test -run '^$' -bench '^BenchmarkHotPathReview/(no-owner|active-clean)/(split-seq-consumed|builder|buffer)/' -benchtime=100ms -count=1 -benchmem -timeout=15m ./iast/propagation

title: Empty-separator Join rescans every element before activity gate
claim: JoinString scans all elements to detect one alias before ActiveStore; all-empty, no-owner inputs take an extra O(n) pass for no possible taint.
repro_command: Copy .omo/review/evidence/perf-hotpath/hotpath_review_test.go into iast/propagation/hotpath_review_test.go in a private checkout; GOTOOLCHAIN=go1.26.6 go test -run '^$' -bench '^BenchmarkHotPathReview/(no-owner|active-clean)/(join-empty|split-seq)' -benchtime=100ms -count=1 -benchmem -timeout=15m ./iast/propagation
